text.tspan: "DE4SDV needs a camera-based driving capability in which a learned checkpoint's plans actually determine the vehicle's steering and acceleration, while the driver sees the genuine plan, vehicle state and health."
"The driving system starts with a pinned checkpoint in one bounded driving scenario, and the vehicle's cameras and motion sensing deliver their first input."

"The vehicle drives the scenario on the checkpoint's plans, AAOS SDV shows the live plan, vehicle state and health, invalid, lost or stale input or plan leads to the defined stop or disable response, and an unavailable AAOS SDV leaves the loop unchanged."
Operate the loop without selecting planning, transport or display
